name: Дыхание
detail: CONCEPT 01 — BREATH. Turn the lower end of the t into one beautifully restrained, open inward curl: a relaxed exhalation, not a closed decorative loop. The terminal should gently turn back toward the stem once and stop, with a fine taper. The circular orbit stays thin, open at upper-right, with a single clean flowing crossbar. Reduce the separate bottom wave from the reference to a faint supporting gesture, so the t's new small terminal has space to breathe. The letter should have a warm pen-drawn character with a slightly fuller downstroke and graceful light upstroke. This concept must feel calm, personal and composed. Small panel label "01 / Breath".
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished, restrained identity concept board for the actual fitness coaching brand "Tatsi in motion".
The supplied image is a DESIGN REFERENCE: the client's favored starting composition, a fine italic lowercase t, flowing crossbar, and open circular orbit. The user wants a small distinctive curl and is dissatisfied with mechanical line-weight variations. Reinterpret with excellent professional calligraphic judgment, optical balance and elegant asymmetry. Preserve recognizability as a t in an airy open circle. Do not copy the exact reference contour; draw a coherent bespoke mark. This is calm mobility, body awareness, strength and freedom of movement for everyday adults, NOT luxury perfume, wedding stationery, aggressive gym branding or a medical clinic.
Palette: white and pale mint #bcf7f3, deep green-black #142627 only as a contrasting presentation background or dark-on-white wordmark. Flat crisp vector-like silhouettes, no gradients, no texture, no glow, no embossed treatments. The logo must have believable smooth curves and intelligent stroke modulation, not a generic script font with a random ornament. Exactly ONE small integrated curl, well under one tenth the logo's total diameter. Lots of clear space, no frame crowding. Avoid large curls, symmetrical flourishes, fake signatures, infinity icons, clipart people, extra symbols or decorative particles.
Board: landscape 4:3, quiet editorial layout, 3 panels with generous gutters. Large left panel about 65 percent of width: a very large mark on deep green with a small readable "Tatsi in motion" wordmark beneath. Right upper panel: a clean miniature website masthead repeating EXACTLY THE SAME mark, the brand name, and the short headline "Move freely." on white, no photo, no invented claims. Right lower panel: a minimal Instagram-style avatar circle and two simple brand post tiles, repeating EXACTLY THE SAME mark, only the short text "in motion", no fake statistics or username. Those are visual applications of the same single logo, not alternative logo proposals. Use sparse readable typography. The focus must remain the large logo, not fancy mockups. Ensure the main mark is large enough to judge the new curl.

Reduce the separate bottom wave from the reference to a faint supporting gesture, so the t's new small terminal has space to breathe. name: Поворот
detail: CONCEPT 02 — PIVOT. Integrate one tiny controlled loop into the far-right terminal of the flowing crossbar, as the line turns around a joint and returns toward the open circle. The loop is small and geometrically disciplined, not a big swash, and connects tangentially with no awkward knot. Let the t be a little more upright and confident than the reference, with a deliberately shaped short curved foot. The circular boundary should be a subtly tilted open oval, with an inviting gap near the small loop. Omit a redundant separate bottom swash to preserve simplicity. This concept expresses controlled rotation, strength and mobility. It should look distinctly more poised and structural than Breath, while sharing the same visual family. Small panel label "02 / Pivot".

name: Подпись
detail: CONCEPT 03 — SIGNATURE. Create a more personal, elegant handwritten lowercase t with a fine expressive crossbar. A tiny returning loop at the LEFT start of the lower circular sweep is the single distinguishing curl; it should become part of the orbit itself rather than a detached doodle. The circle then flows outward smoothly around the t, open at upper-right. Give the t a sophisticated italic rhythm, deliberate contrast between a slender top and a fuller curved descender, and a clean upward terminal with no second loop. The result should feel like one natural practiced signature by a movement coach, compact and memorable, never florid. Eliminate disconnected underlines and unnecessary duplicated curves. Small panel label "03 / Signature".

name: Лёгкость
detail: CONCEPT 04 — LIFT. White t has a graceful pen-drawn downstroke, generous open hook at the bottom and one tiny inward flick at the tip, like an unforced stretch. Shape the top of its ascender as a delicate, gently rounded teardrop, not a blunt diagonal cut. The mint crossbar is a calm, almost horizontal S-curve with a long fine lift to the right. Orbit is extremely open on the right, asymmetrically thin above and fuller below. No separate bottom wave. Keep the letter soft and confidently substantial, with clean counters. Wordmark uses a warm readable contemporary serif. Small label "04 / Lift".
prompt:

name: Опора
detail: CONCEPT 05 — POISE. Make the white lowercase t notably more upright and compact, with a subtle wedge-shaped calligraphic entry at its top, and a short softly sculpted curved foot. It should have the character of a bespoke humanist italic letter, NOT a plain sans-serif stroke. The mint crossbar sweeps around it and terminates in one very small restrained open curl at upper-right. The mint orbit is a slightly wider oval with a purposeful gap on the right, and has a controlled medium stroke. This is the clearest, most robust icon in the set: strength with mobility. No extra bottom wave. Wordmark is a warm clean sans serif, modest, finely spaced. Small label "05 / Poise".

name: Личная линия
detail: CONCEPT 06 — FLOW. Draw a distinctive slim WHITE signature-style t with a slightly taller ascender and an expressive but compact returning loop at its lower terminal. The white stroke varies delicately from narrow ascender to a fuller curved base. One MINT ribbon-like crossbar appears to continue naturally into the open orbit, a single fluid trajectory suggesting uninterrupted movement. Make the main circle slightly irregular in a masterful hand-drawn way, not geometric wobbles: broad left arc, lighter top-right release. The small returning loop belongs only to the white letter; no second curl. Strong optical balance and restraint, sophisticated personal coaching signature, no ornamental wedding calligraphy. Wordmark uses a graceful restrained serif with generous space. Small label "06 / Flow".
